apptainer.install: official apptainer_1.5.4_amd64.deb extracted with dpkg-deb -x (no root); etc/ moved under usr/ for the relocatable layout; libsubid.so.4 from Ubuntu libsubid4 deb, reached via patchelf rpath on apptainer and starter
apptainer.why_ignore_subuid: /etc/subuid lists the user but newuidmap (uidmap package) is not installed

findings_fixed_in_definition: %post under unprivileged fakeroot failed on the CUDA base: libfakeroot.so needs GLIBC_2.38, Ubuntu 22.04 has 2.35. %post removed; %files keeps the git executable bit.
%test run as mapped root with HOME=/root on the read-only image: spacr-run could not create ~/.spacr/runs (Errno 30). %test now goes through entrypoint.sh, whose writable-HOME fallback handles it.

entrypoint.sh would have linked the user's real ~/.cellpose/models and ~/.spacr/models to an image-only /models under Apptainer; it now links nothing there and hands /models to Cellpose only when it is a mount point.
